name: MGA Zone 56 forward and inverse (GDA2020 / MGA zone 56 — EPSG::7856)

source.page: EPSG registry + EPSG Geomatics Guidance Note 7-2 §1.3.5 (Transverse Mercator)
source.notes: Transverse Mercator, central meridian 153°E, latitude of origin 0°, false easting 500000 m, false northing 10000000 m (southern hemisphere), scale factor 0.9996, GRS80 ellipsoid. Input geographic coordinates are GDA2020 (EPSG:7844) — effectively WGS84 at the 1-m level for this fixture's purpose. Expected values frozen from a single pyproj run (EPSG:4326 → EPSG:7856) validated against the sidecar Snyder series (USGS PP-1395 §8) — differences <0.001 m.

cases.name: Sydney (−33.8688°, 151.2093° → MGA 56)
cases.notes: Sydney Opera House vicinity. Cross-checked with pyproj EPSG:4326 → EPSG:7856 (E=334368.6336, N=6250948.3455). Sidecar Snyder forward gives identical E within 0.0001 m.

roundtrip_test.description: Forward then inverse must reproduce the input geographic coordinates to within 1e-7 deg (~1 cm).
